item.title: Ars Technica: Our newsroom AI policy
item.description:
📝 Where we use AI tools in our workflow, we use them with standards and oversight, and humans make every editorial decision. Our journalism is human-authored Ars Technica’s editorial text is written by humans. These tools can recommend changes; only humans can make them.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/staff/2026/04/our-newsroom-ai-policy/

item.title: Arch Linux Now Has a Bit-for-Bit Reproducible Docker Image
item.description:
📝 Documentation to reproduce this Docker image is available here. Remove the ldconfig auxiliary cache file (which introduces non-determinism) from the built image in the Dockerfile: TYPE NAME INPUT-0 INPUT-1 File var/cache/ldconfig/aux-cache 656b08db599dbbd9eb0ec663172392023285ed6598f74a55326a3d95cdd5f5d0 ffee92304701425a85c2aff3ade5668e64bf0cc381cfe0a5cd3c0f4935114195 Normalize timestamps during docker build / podman build using the --source-date-epoch=$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and --rewrite-timestamp options: TYPE NAME INPUT-0 INPUT-1 File etc/ 2026-03-31 07:57:46 +0000 UTC 2026-03-31 07:59:21 +0000 UTC File etc/ld. cache 2026-03-31 07:57:46 +0000 UTC 2026-03-31 07:59:21 +0000 UTC File etc/os-release 2026-03-31 07:57:46 +0000 UTC 2026-03-31 07:59:21 +0000 UTC File sys/ 2026-03-31 07:57:46 +0000 UTC 2026-03-31 07:59:21 +0000 UTC File var/cache/ 2026-03-31 07:57:46 +0000 UTC 2026-03-31 07:59:21 +0000 UTC File var/cache/ldconfig/ 2026-03-31 07:57:46 +0000 UTC 2026-03-31 07:59:21 +0000 UTC File proc/ 2026-03-31 07:57:46 +0000 UTC 2026-03-31 07:59:21 +0000 UTC File dev/ 2026-03-31 07:57:46 +0000 UTC 2026-03-31 07:59:21 +0000 UTC You can check the related change set in our archlinux-docker repository for more details.
🔗 Read more: https://antiz.fr/blog/archlinux-now-has-a-reproducible-docker-image/
